description:
How closely two people's 23, 28 and 33-day cycles run together: per cycle the phase offset in days and 50 x (1 + cos(2 pi x offset / period)), and their mean. The offset is set at birth, so the figure never changes. A historical model with no evidential support, returned with that disclaimer.

[Group: Wellness]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/wellness/biorhythm/compatibility]
[Required: birthDateA, birthDateB]
[Cost: 10 credits (Tier 1)]
